# Oli Treadwell

Senior Software Engineer and Accessibility Advocate in Wellington, New Zealand. 10+ years building for the web: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL.

- [Home](https://olitreadwell.github.io/): about, skills, projects, community, open source
- [Refer Me](https://olitreadwell.github.io/refer/): pre-filled referral messages for recruiters and hiring managers
- [Recommend Me](https://olitreadwell.github.io/recommend/): prompts and pre-filled email for writing a recommendation
- [Resume repo](https://github.com/olitreadwell/resume): full resume, portfolio projects, hiring questions, recommendations
